name: Saint-Émilion Grand Cru

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Saint-Émilion's own classification, first published in 1955 and revised since. Plain Saint-Émilion Grand Cru is an appellation, not part of this ranking.

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation for red wine, covering eight communes around Saint-Émilion and part of Libourne. Wines are made from Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec and Carmenère.
